ad_intro:
upGrad (upgrad.com, Ronnie Screwvala-founded, Mumbai) is India's largest online higher-education platform for working professionals with Rs.1,569 Cr FY25 revenue and ~100 active creatives running across Meta in India, spending an estimated Rs.3-6 Cr/mo on the channel (FY25 total ad spend was Rs.304 Cr, -11% YoY as management targets EBITDA). The brand pushes online degrees, MBAs, executive programs and certifications in Data Science, AI/ML, Generative AI, Digital Marketing and Study Abroad, with lead magnets dominated by 'Download Brochure' PDF gates.

Three obvious leaks in the funnel: (1) Creative is brochure-led, not outcome-led - ~60-70% of ads are static university-logo carousels with 'Download Brochure' as the primary hook; real alumni salary-hike / promotion UGC is thin, even though working professionals buy outcomes (CTC jumps, hiring partners), not PDFs. (2) Lead-form quality gap - primary CTA is a multi-field brochure gate producing high lead volume but low counselor-call show-rate (industry 18-28% for brochure-gated leads); Instant Forms default without Meta's 'Higher Intent' qualifier, diluting CAPI signal. (3) Retargeting stops at brochure-open - 7/14-day brochure-opener pools served generic creative, with no placement-proof, hiring-partner-logo, EMI, or objection-handling layers.

Competitive pressure is rising: Simplilearn grew live-learning revenue 65% YoY, Great Learning hit Rs.847 Cr/quarter (+33%), and Scaler owns the 'salary jump' UGC template for engineers. upGrad is acquiring Unacademy and targeting EBITDA - a 25% CAC lift = ~Rs.60 Cr annualized back to the bottom line. These are fixable in 7 days. We estimate 35-45% of ad spend is leaking; strong WARM lead.

findings: Creative leak: ~60-70% of active Meta ads are static or lightly-animated university-logo carousels leading with 'Download Brochure'. Career-outcome creative (alumni salary jump, promotion stories, hiring-partner cred, placement demos) is thin. For a high-ticket Rs.2-10 Lakh purchase, working professionals buy outcomes (CTC hikes, network, promotion), not PDFs. Edtech benchmarks consistently show alumni/story UGC drives 2-3x higher lead-to-call conversion than brochure ads; the current mix leaves huge CTR and CPL upside on the table.

Lead-form quality leak: Primary CTA is a multi-field form gated by a brochure PDF. This produces high lead volume but low counselor-call show-rate (industry-wide 18-28% for brochure-gated leads vs 40-55% for qualified outcome-led leads). Instant Forms appear to use the default 'More Volume' type without Meta's 'Higher Intent' qualifier (which adds a review step, cuts accidental submissions, lifts lead-to-meeting 15-25% per Meta's own 2026 lead-gen playbook). Sales team burns cycles on tire-kickers, and CAPI enrollment signal is diluted because the algorithm optimizes on form-submits rather than qualified-leads or enrollments.

Landing page leak: Brochure-gate landing pages are generic per program category, with weak placement proof above the fold (no avg. CTC hike, no hiring-partner logos, no live EMI calculator). Primary CTA is 'Download Brochure' rather than direct calendar-book with a counselor; the extra friction (PDF download -> wait for callback -> qualification) adds 24-48 hours of lead decay. Mobile experience is heavy on university logos and light on sticky CTA bar + social proof.

Tracking & retargeting leak: Retargeting pools are 7-14 day brochure-openers and landing-page abandoners, but creative stays brochure/generic rather than layering placement proof (Rs.X lakh CTC jump), hiring-partner logos, EMI, and objection-handling (time commitment, degree recognition, EMI options). CAPI appears to fire on form-submit rather than qualified-lead or enrollment events, which starves the algorithm of the signal that matters. No 'live Q&A with counselor' event retargeting; no alumni-testimonial retargeting layer.

wins: WIN 1 - Creative: 30 Alumni-Outcome UGC Reels (Salary Hike, Promotion, Hiring Manager)

Shoot 30 sixty-second vertical Reels monthly featuring real alumni: (a) 10 salary-hike stories (before/after CTC, role transition), (b) 8 promotion/career-switch narratives (non-tech to PM, SDE to ML eng), (c) 6 hiring-manager/mentor credibility clips, (d) 6 student-experience reels (weekend class, live project, capstone). Lead each hook with a specific number ('Rs.8 Lakh to Rs.23 Lakh in 13 months') in the first 3 seconds. Replace 40% of brochure-university creatives with alumni UGC; pair every university-logo ad with an alumni UGC variant in the same ad set to run a direct A/B. Expected: CTR +35-55%, CPL -25-35%, lead-to-call +40-70%. Edtech benchmarks show outcome UGC delivers 2-3x higher lead-to-call CVR vs brochure-led creative.
WIN 2 - CRO: Higher-Intent Lead Forms + Program-Specific Landing Pages with Placement Proof

Switch Instant Forms from default 'More Volume' to Meta's Higher Intent form type with a review step; add 2 qualifying multiple-choice questions (years of work-ex + target intake window) to filter tire-kickers; cap fields at 3 (name/email/phone pre-filled). Replace generic brochure-gate landing pages with program-specific pages: sticky CTA bar, above-fold placement stat (avg. CTC hike, hiring partners, placement support), 3 alumni video testimonials, EMI calculator, and calendar-book with a counselor as the primary CTA (not 'Download Brochure'). Expected: form completion -5% volume but lead-to-call show-rate +40-60%, qualified-lead CVR +30-50%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: CAPI Wired to Qualified-Lead + Enrollment Events + Outcome-Layered Retargeting

Upgrade Meta CAPI to fire QualifiedLead (counselor call completed) and Enrollment (fee paid) events back to Meta - not just form-submit. Wire CRM status back so the algorithm optimizes toward paying learners, not brochure downloaders. Build 4 retargeting audiences layered by funnel depth: (1) page-view no form-fill -> serve alumni outcome Reels + hiring partners, (2) form-fill no call-book -> serve EMI/no-cost-EMI + time-commitment objection handlers, (3) call-attended no-enroll -> serve live Q&A invites + cohort-urgency, (4) past-program alumni -> serve referral / up-sell to next-degree. Add a 24h 'incomplete form' reminder sequence via WhatsApp/email. Expected: recapture 15-25% of stalled leads; ROAS on retargeting +50-80%; CAC -20% within 30 days of CAPI event upgrade.
